name: VehicleStockFloorplanAudit
tagline: Scan every financed car, catch sold-out-of-trust units and stay ahead of curtailments.
description: A complete dealer floorplan app for Power Apps: VIN scan audit by location with sign-off, sold-out-of-trust detection and payoffs, curtailment schedule, interest exposure, aging and lender credit-line use – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: VIN barcode / last-8 / stock-number scanning by location
Found, wrong location, explained and not-found results with unknown-scan list
Audit sign-off with rules, acknowledgement and summary
Sold-out-of-trust detection against lender payoff terms
Mark sold, pay off (bulk), unwind and reverse payoff with validation
Curtailment schedule from lender terms with payment recording
Interest per day, 30-day and accrued per lender; credit-line use
Power Fx outputs and events, demo mode, phone layout
